comments.author: muellerzr
comments.body:
@984881878 the issue involves `flush=True`, so as a temporary "fix" just don't use `flush=True`. When trying with flush I was noticing it took quite a long time to print in the old version, I'll try and see what exactly could be the difference now. 

And you can then manually flush as well and have it work. Such that:
```python
from accelerate import Accelerator
import sys

accelerator = Accelerator()

with accelerator.main_process_first():
    print(f'Process: {accelerator.process_index}, {accelerator.is_main_process}')
    sys.stdout.flush()
```

```python

from accelerate import Accelerator
accelerator = Accelerator()
with accelerator.local_main_process_first():

```
